title: Te Patunga Tapu i Manakohia i roto i te Aroha
intro: Katia ō kanohi, ka whakaaroaro ki tētahi awaawa nui, puku hoki e whakamatautauria ai te whakapono ki tōna mutunga. Kei te tata koe te tūtaki ki tētahi tangata nāna i ngohengohe mārire i te aroaro o tētahi whakahau e kore e taea te whakaaro, ā, nā tōna ngohengohe mārire i tahuri te wā o te whakamātautau hei tohu mutunga kore o te ngohengohe me te aroha noa o te Atua.
clues: E maumaharatia ana ahau i roto i te Quran i roto i te hunga i whakamanawanui me te manawanui.
I waenganui ahau o tētahi moemoeā i whakamātautau i te ngohengohe ki te whakahau a Allah.
I taku rongonga i te kitenga, ka mea atu ahau kia meatia taku i whakahau ai, ā, ka kitea ahau e koe i roto i te hunga manawanui.
I whakatakotoria ahau mō te patunga tapu, engari i karanga a Allah kua tutuki te moemoeā.
I hokona ahau e Allah ki tētahi patunga tapu nui, ā, i waiho mai he honore mōku i roto i ngā whakatupuranga o muri mai.
Ko ahau a Ismail, nā rāua ko Ibrahim i whakaara ngā turanga o te Whare Tapu, i whakahuatia tahitia me Idris rāua ko Dhul-Kifli i roto i te hunga tika.
